description: Google is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large-scale distributed software solutions. Minimum qualifications: BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, 5+ years of software development experience with Python, Go, C++, or Java. Google is an Equal Opportunity Employer and never requests application or onboarding fees.
message: Thank you for expressing interest in our engineering openings. Please submit your application via the official Google Careers portal.
